label: row_0
context: This table reports a Hammett substituent series for the acid-catalyzed hydration of para-substituted styrenes. The reaction proceeds through benzylic carbocation intermediates stabilized by resonance with the aromatic ring. Electron-donating substituents accelerate the rate by increasing electron density and stabilizing the carbocation, whereas electron-withdrawing substituents slow the reaction. The data span over four orders of magnitude and illustrate the basis of the σ⁺/ρ⁺ correlation, showing that resonance donation and withdrawal dominate over simple inductive effects in determining the effective stabilization of the delocalized carbocation intermediate.
